mapper.select: SELECT ID, APPLY_NO, APPLICANT, APPLY_TIME, USER_O_CODE, USER_O_NAME, ACCOUNT, ORG, FINANCIER, ENABLED, TEL, EMAIL, MOBILE, THEME_CFG_JSON, COLLECT_CFG_JSON, STATUS, CURRENT_APPROVER, APPROVE_START_TIME, APPROVE_END_TIME, REMARK, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME FROM SYS_RBAC_USER_APPLY WHERE APPLY_NO = #{applyNo}

SELECT ua.* FROM SYS_RBAC_USER_APPLY ua INNER JOIN SYS_RBAC_USER_APPLY_AUDIT audit ON ua.APPLY_ID = audit.APPLY_ID WHERE ua.STATUS = 'PENDING' -- AND audit.APPROVER = #{approver} AND audit.APPROVE_RESULT IS NULL ORDER BY ua.APPLY_TIME DESC
